claim: A single read-only snapshot can separate missing GPU, CPU scaling, network, cellular, camera and touch devices before functional tests.
oracle: The snapshot emits valid JSON with explicit presence lists and bounded metrics, never starts hardware and never includes identifying fields.

user_journey.scenario: After a boot or a failed Agent launch, the maintainer runs the snapshot before touching the phone again.
user_journey.expected: The maintainer can see whether the relevant device node or interface exists and chooses the next gate without guessing.

invariants: Only sysfs, procfs and device-node presence are read.
No module, radio, route, camera frame or GPU job is started.
Presence is labelled as diagnostic evidence and never as feature acceptance.
gitnexus: The package stages the same snapshot used by the public tools copy.
The snapshot has no boot, modem, flash or network-configuration caller.
ast: The script has no write calls or shell execution path.
Test roots are injectable fixtures, while phone defaults remain /sys and /dev.

unit.red: Existing readiness output did not expose cellular control nodes, CPU governors or media nodes in one bounded report.
unit.green: Fixtures cover render, Wi-Fi, USB, cellular control, camera, input and schedutil presence with JSON parsing and redaction.

evidence: Offline fixture and Oriole package tests pass; live phone execution remains pending.

limitations: Presence does not prove smooth frames, registration, camera capture or touch usability.
The report does not query modem identities or carrier state.
exit_gate: Run on a cold normal Omarchy boot, compare with independent sysfs reads, then proceed to GPU frame, Wi-Fi reconnect, China Mobile bearer and camera capture gates.
